capabilities: Manage tasks in custom lists with priorities, subtasks, reminders, due dates, and recurring schedules
Plan goals as yearly, quarterly, monthly, and weekly items with parent-child links and lifecycle states
Suggest tasks for My Day from local rules based on weekly goals
Review daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly completion statistics
Move, restore, and organize tasks across lists and a recycle bin
extras: Not yet listed in the Community plugins directory (manual install from GitHub releases described); renamed from obsidian-todo with one-way settings migration; not reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest; all data and suggestions stay local with no account or network needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structured task system with lists, My Day, goal hierarchies, schedules, and review statistics.

relations.evidence: If you previously installed the plugin as obsidian-todo, disable the old plugin before enabling Plan to Day.

summary: Microsoft To-Do style task manager that breaks goals into yearly, quarterly, monthly, and weekly plans and turns them into daily tasks.
